structured_stats.description:
'''Sandbox'''  mode is a mode unlocked by being {{Level|250}} or by purchasing the [[Gamepasses|Sandbox Plus+ gamepass]], and can only be played through [[Matchmaking]].

'''Sandbox''' mode allows experimenting with various parts of the game. For the most part, this is limited to things available to the players through regular gameplay, though some unused or legacy content has also been made available here, either for free or by owning the Sandbox Plus+ gamepass. However, that is limited only to towers the player has in their inventory and enemies need to have their [[Logbooks]] collected (though modern enemy [[Logbooks]] also unlock legacy enemies in '''Sandbox''' as long as the player has the Sandbox Plus+ gamepass) to be spawned in '''Sandbox''' mode.

Modes can only be started if they were beaten by the player. Units can be summoned, though there appears to be no restrictions on which can be summoned. Any consumables that were whitelisted by the developers can be used. For maps, it has to be triumphed on any difficulty for it to be able to be selected in '''Sandbox''' mode, though not all maps appear in the selection, meaning not all of them can be picked. The music section allows for the soundtrack to be changed to any soundtrack whitelisted by the developers.

With the Sandbox Plus+ gamepass, all restrictions are removed. This makes the modifiers, challenges and stat editor sections open, while most content that was restricted behind progression (for example, gathering [[Logbooks]] or triumphing maps) is instantly unlocked. This also unlocks some things which would be impossible to collect in regular gameplay, making them Sandbox Plus+ exclusive. It also unlocks multiple options seen on the sidebar, including infinite cash, infinite towers, invincible, consumable cooldowns, and allows [[Time Scale]] to be set past 2. It also allows players to start matches with up to six people instead of the usual four. Sandbox Plus+ can also be given to three other players, granting them most of the benefits. Players can also be kicked from the match or blacklisted during a match.

'''Sandbox''' mode contains a large number of content which is normally, not available in-game. A list of pages which are primarily about '''Sandbox''' only content can be found [[:Category:Sandbox Only|here]].

{{ModeTabs|Story = No}} {{ModeInfobox |title1 = {{Color|CasualMode}} |image1 = GraveDiggerEasyIcon.png |waves = 25 |level_requirement = None |starting_cash = {{Money|500}}
{{Money|600}} (Group Bonus) |time = 10:00 |rewards = {{Coins|450}}, {{Exp|90}} & {{TowerExp|50}} }} {{QuoteContainer| {{QuoteBox|For players who are looking for a casual experience.|Description in Elevators}} }} ==Description== '''Casual''' mode is one of the six main survival modes. The mode has 25 waves, and the final boss is [[Grave Digger]]. Cash is only gained if an enemy is killed, or in some cases, damaged by a specific amount of health. Additionally, the amount gained is a set amount of cash, which is not always equal to the enemy's health. It uses a slightly different method of distributing cash between players, as enemies split their cash between players, regardless of how much damage the player dealt to it. If, in a duo, one player does all the damage to an enemy, both players will receive 50% of the cash the enemy would normally give in solo. This means that in solo, you receive 100% of the cash when an enemy is killed, or it is damaged enough. With each additional player, this is reduced to 50% in duo, 33% in trio and 25% in quad. If it is a decimal, it gets rounded up or down depending on the decimal value. If it is at least 0.5, it gets rounded up. If it is less than 0.5, it gets rounded down. ==Rewards== The game calculates how many {{Coins|Coins}} and {{Exp|}} you receive based on how many waves you survived and if you won a match. During periods of 100% more {{Exp|}} (Friday – Sunday), any {{Exp|}} earned is multiplied by 2x through the [[XP Boost]] modifier. The VIP [[Gamepasses|gamepass]] also multiplies any {{Exp|}} earned by 1.25x through the [[VIP Boost]] modifier. These two boosts are additive. Some maps like [[Mason Arch]] can also increase all rewards by a specific amount. Regular {{Exp|}} boosts are multiplicative with other modifiers. Any rewards that end in a decimal point is rounded down, no matter the first figure of the leading decimal. Rewards are calculated as: {| class="tds-table pad-10" style="text-align: center; margin:1em auto" !Coins Reward !EXP Reward !Tower EXP Reward |- |{{Coins|400}} ÷ (1 + [(25 ÷ Current Wave) - 1]^1.3) + {{Coins|50}} (Triumph Bonus) |{{Exp|75}} ÷ (1 + [(25 ÷ Current Wave) - 1]) + {{Exp|15}} (Triumph Bonus) |{{TowerExp|20}} ÷ (1 + [(25 ÷ Current Wave) - 1]) + {{TowerExp|30}} (Triumph Bonus) |} Triumphing '''Casual''' mode can give out an additional reward, which can be a crate, consumable or ticket. They are meant to be guaranteed, though due to a bug this does not always happen. Additionally, items are sometimes not given out. These items are: *{{Color|Common}} (50%) **[[Grenade]] (1-2) **[[Flash Bang]] (1-2) **[[Molotov]] (1-2) **[[Easter Egg]] (1-2) *{{Color|Uncommon}} (30%) **{{TimeScaleTicket|Time Scale Ticket}} **{{ReviveTicket|Revive Ticket}} *{{Color|Rare}} (20%) **[[Low Grade Crate]] **{{SpinTicket|Spin Ticket}} **[[Barricade]] **[[Supply Drop]] **[[AirStrike]] **[[Ducky Squad]] ===Badges/Achievements=== There are [[badges]] and achievements that you can or could obtain when playing this mode, which may have additional rewards alongside them. These are: {{Badge |title = Defeat Grave Digger |description = Get ready to have your grave dug! |image = D11EasyBadge.png |obtainable = Yes }} {{Badge |title = Average Joe |description = Triumph in Casual mode |image = Achievement |obtainable = Yes |rewards = {{Coins|150}} }} ===Seasons=== During some [[Passes]], the '''Casual''' mode could give currency rewards which you used to progress through a season. 40% (Quad) |time = 18:00 |rewards = {{Coins|1,350}}, {{Exp|250}} & {{TowerExp|185}} }} {{QuoteContainer| {{QuoteBox|For players who are experts at the game and want to test their limits.|Description in Elevators}} }} __TOC__ ==Description== '''Fallen''' mode, formerly called '''Insane''' mode, is one of the six main survival modes. '''Fallen''' mode has 40 waves. When the [[Hidden Wave]] is activated it has 42 waves. The mode is named after the Fallen enemies that appear throughout it. Cash is only gained if an enemy is killed, or in some cases, damaged by a specific amount of health. Additionally, the amount gained is a set amount of cash, which is not always equal to the enemy's health. It uses a slightly different method of distributing cash between players, as enemies split their cash between players, regardless of how much damage the player dealt to it. If, in a duo, one player does all the damage to an enemy, both players will receive 50% of the cash the enemy would normally give in solo. This means that in solo, you receive 100% of the cash when an enemy is killed, or it is damaged enough. With each additional player, this is reduced to 50% in duo, 33% in trio and 25% in quad. If it is a decimal, it gets rounded up or down depending on the decimal value. If it is at least 0.5, it gets rounded up. If it is less than 0.5, it gets rounded down. The health of enemies in this mode scales with the player count, starting at two players. The increase is 15% in duo, 25% in trio and 40% in quad. It is applied after attributes, like [[Bloated]], meaning they can affect the health of an enemy. The increase is not always the stated amount. You can activate the [[Hidden Wave]] by following these certain steps: *Every player has to disable [[Skills]] before starting the match. *After voting '''Fallen''' mode, sending separate messages that contain these numbers in the chat: "''120''", "''1''" and "''1009''". On the last number, the screen will flash and a noise will play. *The base health should be set to one before reaching to Wave 40. *Defeat the [[Fallen King]] under 60 seconds without using consumables on Wave 40. If done successfully instead of dropping its sword and vanishing in a beam of light, it will survive, but smashing the ground enraged and retreating with its sword. *After completing [[Hidden Wave]], the icon of '''Fallen''' mode on the difficulty select screen will change to the [[Awakened Fallen King]]. ==Rewards== ''For former rewards, see this mode's [[Fallen Mode/Rewards|Rewards]] page.'' The game calculates how many {{Coins|Coins}} and {{Exp|}} you receive based on how many waves you survived and if you won a match. During periods of 100% more {{Exp|}} (Friday – Sunday), any {{Exp|}} earned is multiplied by 2x through the [[XP Boost]] modifier. The VIP [[Gamepasses|gamepass]] also multiplies any {{Exp|}} earned by 1.25x through the [[VIP Boost]] modifier. These two boosts are additive. Some maps like [[Mason Arch]] can also increase all rewards by a specific amount. Regular {{Exp|}} boosts are multiplicative with other modifiers. Any rewards that end in a decimal point is rounded down, no matter the first figure of the leading decimal.
